how: Post titles and URLs from web searches restricted to sfbike.org, run 2026-09-29. sfbike.org answers scripted requests with a Cloudflare 403, so the posts themselves were not opened; each `claim` paraphrases the search engine's summary of the post and carries [web search — verify]. `nodes` are the SFMTA project pages (sfmta.com/node/<id>) the post is about, chosen by hand from out/sfmta-projects/projects.json by project name and street; an empty list means no SFMTA project in that mirror matches.

The Embarcadero 2020 Quick-Build Projects (node 21903) cover other stretches. The mirror has no page for Bay to Chestnut.
